node.statement: Conditional on validation of node 1.3, fix i,j and apply node 1.3 with z=Z_{ji}. Since Z_{ji} is in S_{P,R}, node 1.2.1 gives Z_{ji}^dagger in S_{R,P}; hence node 1.3 yields Ha^Q_{R,P}(Z_{ji}^dagger)=Ha^Q_{P,R}(Z_{ji})^dagger. By node 1.4.1 the right-hand side is the (i,j) block of (Ha^Q_{P,R})_n(Z)^dagger, while entrywise amplification and (Z^dagger)_{ij}=Z_{ji}^dagger identify the left-hand side as the (i,j) block of (Ha^Q_{R,P})_n(Z^dagger). Thus all blocks agree. This step is structurally dependent on nodes 1.2.1, 1.3, and 1.4.1 and cannot be accepted before node 1.3 is validated.
